overview: The Medford Historical Commission held significance determinations for several properties facing demolition and received updates on local preservation projects and zoning.

items.title: 15 Maple Park Avenue (Hegner Center)
items.summary: The preferably preserved hearing was tabled to October 5th because the petitioners did not install a yard sign in time.

items.title: 67 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: The Commission voted to pass on demolition review because the structure does not meet the age requirement.

items.title: 71 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: The Commission voted to find the property historically significant, which triggers a preferably preserved hearing next month.

items.title: 73 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: The Commission voted to pass on demolition review because the structure does not meet the age requirement.

items.title: 81 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: The Commission voted to pass on demolition review because the structure does not meet the age requirement.

items.title: 78 Circuit Road
items.summary: A motion to find the property historically significant failed.

items.title: 146 Spring Street
items.summary: A motion to find the property historically significant failed.

items.title: 73 Surry Street
items.summary: The Commission voted to find the property historically significant, triggering a preferably preserved hearing next month.

items.title: 321 Winthrop Street (American Legion Building)
items.summary: The Commission discussed a potential redevelopment project for veterans housing and decided to request an updated inventory form for the site.

items.title: Boston Avenue Zoning Update
items.summary: Doug Carr reported that the Boston Avenue zoning draft was finalized and submitted to the City Council.

items.title: Medford High School Survey
items.summary: Adam Hurtubise reported that exterior photography of the high school has been completed for a future area form.

items.title: Cross Street Cemetery Restoration
items.summary: Adam Hurtubise provided updates on headstone restorations, the discovery of buried headstones, and upcoming ground-penetrating radar testing.

items.title: Brooks Estate Neighborhood Survey
items.summary: Adam Hurtubise reported on efforts to secure oversight and feedback from Mass Historical for the project.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The Commission approved the meeting minutes from August.
